sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use with a Stormcast Eternals army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. The Path to Glory content in this book is divided into two parts; the Anvil of Apotheosis and Paths for Stormcast Eternals units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
You can have 1 Anvil of Apotheosis hero on your Order of Battle and/or army roster, unless otherwise specified in the battlepack you are using. They can be your warlord.
There are 7 steps to follow to create your hero:
1. Set a destiny point limit.
2. Fill out the starting warscroll.
3. Choose a Chamber.
4. Pick your hero's origin and/or flaw.
5. Choose a Battle Mount.
6. Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades.
7. Pick any other upgrades.

sections.name: Step 1 - Set a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be. Pick 1 of the following:
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Stormcast Eternals Knight | 10 | 150
Stormcast Eternals Templar | 30 | 250
Stormcast Eternals Lord | 50 | 350
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

sections.name: Step 3 - Choose a Chamber
sections.text:
You must pick 1 of the following Chambers for your hero to belong to:
Warrior Chamber
-0DP
Your hero gains the WARRIOR CHAMBER keyword and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any WARRIOR CHAMBER units
Vanguard Chamber
-4DP
Your hero gains the VANGUARD CHAMBER keyword and the following ability and regiment options:
Passive
VANGUARD CHAMBER
Effect: This unit can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.
Regiment Options | Any VANGUARD CHAMBER units
Extremis Chamber
-4DP
Your hero gains the EXTREMIS CHAMBER keyword and the following ability and regiment options:
Passive
EXTREMIS CHAMBER
Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets l his unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.
Regiment Options | Any EXTREMIS CHAMBER units
Ruination Chamber
-4DP
Your hero gains the RUINATION CHAMBER keyword and the following ability and regiment options:
Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This, unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE abilily
RUINATION CHAMBER
Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
Regiment Options | Any RUINATION CHAMBER units

sections.name: Step 4 - Pick Your Hero's Origin And/Or Flaw
sections.text: You can pick up to 1 origin and up to 1 flaw for your hero. Each adds an ability to your hero’s warscroll. However, instead of costing destiny points, flaws give you extra destiny points to spend elsewhere.

sections.name: Origins
sections.text:
Your Charge Phase
-4DP
TRIBAL WARLEADER
Declare: Pick up to 2 other friendly units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for this unit and the targets.
Passive
-2DP
SNATCHED FROM THE GRAVE
Effect: Enemy units cannot use the’ Rally’ command while they are within 18" of this unit.
Passive
-2DP
FRESHLY FORGED
Effect: When this unit earns the Aspiring rank on its Path, it gets both the abilities for that rank instead of just one of them.
End of Any Turn
-4DP
REDEEMED
Declare: Pick up to 2 other friendly units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
Effect: Heal (D3) this unit and each target.

sections.name: Flaws
sections.text:
Passive
+4DP
FRACTURED SOUL
Declare: This unit must use this ability at the end of each turn.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, allocate l damage point to this unit (a ward roll cannot be made for that damage point).
Passive
+4DP
FUELLED BY HATRED
Effect: In each combat phase, if this unit is in combat and does not have STRIKE-LAST, after friendly units with STRIKE-FIRST have been picked to use a FIGHT ability, this unit must be the next friendly unit that is picked to use a FIGHT ability.
Passive
+2DP
UNVANQUISHABLE PRIDE
Effect: This unit cannot use RETREAT abilities.
Passive
+4DP
BRASH AND IMPULSIVE
Effect: This unit cannot contest objectives.

sections.name: Step 5 - Choose a Battle Mount
sections.text: You can pick up to l Battle Mount for your hero. If your hero has the EXTREMIS CHAMBER keyword, you must pick a Battle Mount for them.

sections.name: BATTLE MOUNTS
sections.text:
Battle Mount
-5DP
NOBLE BEAST: There are many warbeasts employed by the Stormcast Eternals in battle, from Gryph-chargers to Dracoths - or even the rarely seen Dracolines.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Noble Beast's Claws
Companion | 3 | 4+ | 3+ | 2 | 1
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 10".
Change the Health characteristic to 8.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the CAVALRY keyword.
Battle Mount
-10DP
FLYING NOBLE BEAST: Some champions of the Stormcast Eternals take to battle upon a great winged beast such as a Draconith or Tauralon.
Add the following weapon and ability to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Noble Beast's Claws
Companion | 4 | 4+ | 2+ | 2 | 2
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 12".
Change the Health characteristic to 12.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the following keywords: MONSTER, FLY.
Battle Mount
-20DP
MIGHTY FLYING NOBLE BEAST: Some of the greatest leaders of the Stormcasts have bonded with an awe-inspiring creature such as a Stardrake or ominous Morrgryph.
Add the following weapon and ability to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Mighty Flying Noble Beast's Claws
Companion | 6 | 4+ | 2+ | 2 | 2
Passive
BATTLE DAMAGED Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Mighty Flying Noble Beast's Claws is 4.
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 12".
Change the Health characteristic to 16.
Change the Control characteristic to 5.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the following keywords: MONSTER, FLY.

sections.text:

sections.name: Path of The Storm
sections.text:
(STORMCAST ETHERNALS HERO only)
ASPIRING: When a HERO on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
INDOMITABLE SOUL
Effect: Add 1 to this unit’s Health characteristic.
Passive
STRENGTH OF THE TEMPEST
Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks.
ELITE: When a HERO on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
NOBLE DEFENDER
Effect: For the rest of the turn, if a friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the’ All-out Defence’ command, no command points are spent.
Passive
LIGHTNING-WREATHED WEAPONS
Effect: Thls unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).
MIGHTY: When a HERO on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
THE GOD-KING'S FAVOUR
Effect: This unit has WARD (5+).
End of Any Turn
CELESTIAL HALO
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be targets.
Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
LEGENDARY: When a HERO on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Reaction: You declared the’ Counter-charge’ command for this unit
BOLD TACTICIAN
Effect: Pick another friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. After the’ Counter-charge’ command for this unit has been resolved, if this unit charged, the target can immediately use the ’Counter-charge’ command without any command points being spent.
Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
SIGMAR'S JUDGEMENT
Effect: This unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

sections.name: Path of The Redeemer
sections.text:
(non-HERO STORMCAST ETERNALS only)

MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:

Passive
LIGHTNING-WREATHED WEAPONS

INDOMITABLE SOULS
